versions.changelog:
- Initial release: wraps TRPG file abbreviations (e.g. HP, DC, AC) into "Chinese full term (ABBR)" format for consistency and player comprehension.
- Supports .md/.txt and .xlsx files; skips old, backup, v1, or draft versions by default.
- Idempotent: repeat runs produce no further changes, preventing double-wrap errors.
- Uses project-specific abbreviation mapping; warns that mappings are not universal.
- Auto-validates results and includes a checklist for clean delivery.
- Designed for pre-release terminology cleanup of TRPG rules, modules, and character sheets.
